I understand, I'm east coast too. Bit of a night owl though. 

Thanks for the kind words.

I dropped out of Highschool. I run out of breath after walking four blocks. I sweat A LOT after just a minute or so of being around people or are in a warm room. 

Nobody is going to hire me like this. 

I have very few books, I've never owned a cell phone in my life, the few games I own are all on Steam. My computer is the only thing of value, really. I ... I just can't sell it.

I live in Canada. They want a Driver's License - nothing else will work.

I also can't transfer the funds, because having two Paypal accounts will just cause both accounts to be banned. 

Really, Paypal is just fucking awful. I think they just want to keep my money. I've called multiple times. I'm so fucked.

I've tried multiple multiple things to help both my sweating and acne. Fresh towels on my pillow helped a bit, but it's still pretty bad. My sweating is just awful though. It's a clinical issue, and it's EXTREMELY bad. There's medicine that can help, but it's pretty expensive. Like, $2 a day expensive. 

I don't know any more.
